newsitem.title: USA: Vitalink gets financing for GranCare deal.
newsitem.headline: Vitalink gets financing for GranCare deal.

text.p: Vitalink Pharmacy Services Inc said on Monday it received commitments for a $200 million credit facility in connection with its pending merger with TeamCare, a pharmacy subsidiary of GranCare Inc.
On September 4, 1996, Vitalink agreed to merge GranCare's institutional pharmacy business, TeamCare, with Vitalink.
The new facility will be used, in part, to refinance certain GranCare debt that Vitalink has agreed to assume in the merger.

"The new credit facility will help strengthen our capital structure and provide additional financial resources to meet our future working capital and acquisition needs for the combined entity," said Donna DeNardo, president and chief operating officer, in a statement.
The proposed merger is expected to be completed in late January 1997.

Earlier today, Vitalink reported earnings for its fiscal 1997 second quarter ended November 30, 1996 rose to $3.9 million or $0.28 a share from $3.4 million or $0.24 last year. Revenues for the second quarter increased 27 percent to $43.3 million.
Vitalink, which operates 23 institutional pharmacies, added new accounts with an additional 1,400 beds during the quarter. This brings the total number of beds serviced to 54,300.
